headline: China’s two-year AI capacity-building report lists programs and self-reported project outcomes
summary: China released a two-year progress report on its AI Capacity-Building Inclusive Plan at the October 23 Xiong’an Global Governance Forum. The 22-page Chinese-language report describes ten action areas spanning open systems, model and industry cooperation, education, language resources, data governance and safety. It reports project examples, including a South African railway case with claimed knowledge-search efficiency gains above 90%, 1.5 hours saved per employee per day, and projected maintenance-cost reductions of at least 30%. These are report-authored figures: the document supplies no evaluation method or partner-country confirmation for them, so they are not independently demonstrated outcomes.
